title: Work: from an initiative huddle to a shared presentation
environment: Local dev:mock portal at http://localhost:5183; local gateway, platform-api and SFU
mediaStatus: All eight full-portrait speaking MP4s delivered with exact encoded-audio ASR and automated timing evidence. Both timed native media/UI flows and both-participant playback are verified. Both original scenes now pass every exact normalized native speech line; initiative retranscription used the existing native pipeline and unchanged recorded media. Human perceptual approval is not claimed.
collaboration: Saved-revision collaboration: a clean deck editor follows a teammate's save within five seconds; unsaved edits are preserved and stale saves conflict. Keystrokes are not co-edited live.

cast.name: Vera Green
cast.voiceDirection: Calm engineering leader, conversational, concise, natural pauses

cast.name: Nora DaSilva
cast.voiceDirection: Practical senior engineer, measured, friendly, explains the next test

preflight: Use separate browser profiles for Vera and Nora so their cookies do not replace one another.
Sign in through /workspaces and enter Work with each actor's stated role.
Use the existing local mock stack; do not reset the shared mock world or deploy cloud changes.
Both actors open /iq/projects/p-observability. Footer Huddle starts the shared initiative call; header Start call rings the owner and SMEs.

Browser device permission is required by the current shared runtime, even with pre-join toggles off. Automated transport checks use synthetic capture; the speaking version uses prepared capture files.

Open initiative Overview with no story selected, then generate the plain deck as Nora, who cannot read budgets, so both actors can open it. /deck Observability review in Agent mode builds it from current initiative facts.
Copy the returned /iq/decks/<id> link into both profiles; never hardcode a generated deck ID.

scenes.goal: Start a huddle, discuss the blocked work, persist an update, search with the call still live, then leave.

turns.speech: Nora, let's look at the duplicate-alert issue. What do we need before we can validate the fix?
turns.action: Start footer Huddle in Vera's profile; the branded two-column device dialog keeps Join visible. Join the same huddle as Nora. Confirm bounded tiles above the central Chat composer and the thread-only right dialogue pane; both navigation rails fold and can be reopened.

turns.speech: The dependency map is still the blocker. Let's make the next step explicit: confirm the affected services, then replay a dependency outage.
turns.action: Open Work → ORG-OBS-11, Stop duplicate alerts during a dependency outage (wi-obs-e2-b4). Inspect its blocker and add a criterion: Confirm the affected service dependency map before replaying the outage. Keep the huddle connected while changing work items.

turns.speech: I've captured that validation step. I'll put the decision in the huddle chat so we have the same context while we search.
turns.action: Choose Chat → To: Huddle in the central composer and send: Next step: confirm the affected service dependency map, then replay the outage. Verify it appears in both right-side transcripts with the resolved public work key. Choose To: Initiative; type /comment and save a work-item note. Check Activity, then another work item: the initiative conversation still contains the contextual note. Choose To: Huddle again.

turns.speech: Search for dependency in this initiative. We can inspect the related work without leaving the call. Then let's close this huddle and review the presentation.
turns.action: Use Search in this initiative. Footer Message focuses the central huddle composer on Search and preserves the shell-owned unfinished huddle draft. Switch to Agent, search dependency, and open ORG-OBS-11. Return to Chat or press footer Message to recover the huddle draft. Keep the bounded tiles and transcript visible. React from the footer smile-plus picker; it closes and floats one emoji. Navigate away and back: the old emoji must not replay. Use Leave on both actors and verify media stops.

scenes.goal: Start a second hangout on the initiative's status presentation, follow a teammate, and save edits from both actors.

turns.speech: Let's make this presentation useful for the review. Nora, can you focus the summary slide while I follow your view?
turns.action: Open the same plain deck in both profiles. Start footer Huddle and join from the second profile. Footer Message opens the thread and focuses the presentation's central huddle composer. Nora selects Summary; Vera uses Follow on Nora's presence avatar. Nora changes to Work by status and Vera must select that slide automatically; return to Summary before editing.

turns.speech: I'll change the summary title to Observability: validation next. The source figures stay intact. I'm saving this as the next version.
turns.action: Nora edits the Summary title and saves a revision. Keep Vera's editor clean; verify the saved title appears there within five seconds.

turns.speech: I can see your saved version. I'll add a speaker note: confirm the dependency map, then replay the outage. Now I'll save my revision.
turns.action: Vera edits speaker notes and saves. Nora remains clean and sees the next saved revision. Verify both edits survive reload.

turns.speech: That gives us a clear next step and a shared presentation. Let's download the PowerPoint and close the hangout.
turns.action: Download the current .pptx, then Leave from both profiles. Verify the call is over and the saved deck remains available.

clipDirection: Use each actor's matching photographic portrait as the character reference. Frame as a natural webcam call, shoulders visible, quiet office background, subtle head motion, exact spoken line, no captions or watermark. Export one MP4 with audible speech per turn. Idle portions use the actor's still portrait during this local demo; they are not generated listening footage.

Initiative, Search, and presentation content remain usable; video tiles are bounded inside the central chat box, including when navigating to another initiative. The social footer owns call controls.
A huddle message is editable in the central composer, acknowledged, and visible to both actors in the right transcript. An unfinished huddle draft survives route changes.
Searching does not drop the call; leaving stops its media.
The deck uses the initiative's existing call authority and its own read/write permission checks.
A clean editor follows saved revisions; a dirty editor keeps its draft and receives a conflict instead of an overwrite.
There are no cartoon fallback avatars on the demo path.
The reaction picker dismisses after selection; reaction history never replays on navigation.
A work-context reference shows its public ORG-OBS key, not a storage ID.
Agent mode follows the app theme. Ordinary people lookup shows self-disclosed credentials and skills.
Sharing a screen adds a separate tile while preserving the participant camera; stopping the share removes only that screen tile.
